title: Say Pangibabaga na Sigpot ya Autoridad
intro: Nensaman, walay sakey a makapanyarin indibidual ya manuley ed maawang a dalin tan ed saray manaayam ditan. Say uley na sayan pigura et atandaan na baleg a panagpaatagey tan baleg ya angat ed madibinon autoridad. Manparaan pian naamtaan so pakabidbiran na sakey a kamarerwa ya say pansumpalan to et nagmaliw ya magnayon a leksion parad amin a kailalakan.
clues: Walay pakayarik ed sakey a mabiskeg ya impirio, a ditan et ganggan so salitak.
Indeklarak so inkasiak a sankatageyan a dios, a mankekerew na panagdayew ed amin a walad silong na uley ko.
Pinairap ko so sakey a komunidad, ya inaripen ko ra tan ingganggan kon pateyen iray ugugaw nin lalaki.
Aminpiga ak ya inarap na sakey a mapaabeban mensahero na Dios, ya nanggawa na malinew iran milagro ed arap ko tan saray managsalamangka ko.
Masebeg ak ya angipulisay ed katwaan, ya inakusaan koy mensahero na panagsalamangka tan manplaplanon maneral ed sikato tan saray patumbok to.
Siak tan say interon armada ko et inawit na dayat legan min ag-ontutundan uusilan iramay nibulos ed pakayarik.

outcome.label: Pansumpalan
options: Nagmaliw a maridios iray totoo to

arabic: فَأَتْبَعَهُمْ فِرْعَوْنُ بِجُنُودِهِۦ فَغَشِيَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْيَمِّ مَا غَشِيَهُمْ
verse: So Pharaoh pursued them with his soldiers, and there covered them from the sea that which covered them, (20:78)
